claims.value: HA-Ub WT or K29R clone c93, with or without 0.5 µg/mL doxycycline for 72 h
claims.evidence: Paper Methods specify the WT and K29R-c93 lines and plus/minus DOX design; file names encode wt/c93 and positive/negative. Positive/negative is mapped to DOX status from the complete 2x2 design.

claims.value: Four independently seeded dishes per group, exact R1-R4 RAW filenames
claims.evidence: Paper says cells were seeded in quadruplicate 15-cm dishes; deposited names encode R1-R4 in each of four groups.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[cleavage agent details], comment[ms1 scan range] rows 1-16
claims.value: Orbitrap Exploris 240, top-10 DDA, trypsin, 375-1600 m/z
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol explicitly describes Exploris 240, data-dependent acquisition, top 10, trypsin digest, and MS1 range. Structured instrument dropdown conflicts and is not used.
PRIDE data-processing protocol states Skyline precursor mass tolerance of 5 ppm.

limitations: The deposit does not enumerate the targeted histone PTM search parameters or all Skyline settings, so modification columns were omitted.
The file-name words positive/negative are interpreted as the plus/minus doxycycline treatments based on the paper design; no separate run manifest spells out the polarity.
The official offline validator warns U-2-OS is absent from its CLO/BTO/EFO cache, while Cellosaurus resolves CVCL_0042.
Donor age and sex were not asserted from the historic cell-line origin; they are not available at study sample level.
